body_lead: CHENNAI: To promote research and innovation in Artificial Intelligence (AI), the state government would soon implement the "Tamil Nadu Artificial Intelligence Mission" (TNAIM) under the chairmanship of Chief Minister M K Stalin. According to the Government Order, in order to leverage the power of AI/Machine Learning (ML) in simplifying governance, the Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency, (TNeGA) would implement the TN AI Mission in collaboration with iTNT, ICT Academy, ELCOT.
